## Why This Benchmark Is Included

Recognized reproducible graph-learning benchmark.

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Classroom value** | Introduces message passing and graph-specific data representation. |
| **Systems behavior** | Sparse gather, scatter, and irregular memory access. |
| **Benchmark lineage** | OGB supplies data, split, evaluator, baseline, and leaderboard. |
| **Model choice** | GCN is the official interpretable baseline. |
| **Dataset choice** | ogbn-arxiv is more system-relevant than tiny citation graphs. |
| **Quality metric** | The OGB evaluator fixes the accuracy computation. |
| **Published baseline** | Official OGB baseline and leaderboard |
| **Alternative rejected** | Cora is useful pedagogically but too small for stable systems measurement. |

| **Field** | **Value** |

| **Quality reference** | [open source](https://ogb.stanford.edu/docs/leader_nodeprop/) |

**Adaptation boundary:** The official three-layer full-batch GCN, symmetric graph, optimizer, 500-epoch schedule, time split, and OGB evaluator are preserved. MLPerf EDU adds measurement, provenance, and reporting.

## How to Run

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
uv run mlperf fetch --workload graph-node-classification --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd.json provenance)
uv run mlperf run --workload graph-node-classification --profile max

# quick smoke pass
uv run mlperf run --workload graph-node-classification --profile min

# research envelope
uv run mlperf run --workload graph-node-classification --profile pro
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.

## Candidate Quality Target

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Metric** | test_accuracy |
| **Target** | 0.7174 |
| **Direction** | higher |
| **Target kind** | published mean with tolerance |
| **Target basis** | literature |
| **Tolerance** | 0.0029 |
| **Reference runs** | 0 |

**Reviewer notes:**

- The target and tolerance are the official OGB ogbn-arxiv leaderboard GCN mean and standard deviation for the 110,120-parameter implementation.
- The previously recorded 72.51 +/- 0.35 percent result belongs to a different leaderboard section and is not the ogbn-arxiv GCN reference.
- MLPerf EDU reports test accuracy at the epoch with the highest official validation accuracy, matching the OGB logger.

## Systems Experiment Execution Contract

**Within-run measurement protocol:**

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Primary metric** | train_and_eval_seconds |
| **Scenario** | training |
| **Timing scope** | 500 full-batch training epochs with official train, validation, and test evaluation after every epoch |
| **Included phases** | full-graph forward and backward passes, optimizer steps, official split evaluation |
| **Excluded phases** | dataset fetching and PyG processing, graph symmetrization and device transfer, model construction, checkpoint serialization, report and provenance serialization |
| **Device synchronization** | synchronize immediately before and after the measured training-and-evaluation region |
| **Outer reference runs** | 5 |
| **Outer preconditioning runs** | 0 |
| **Outer inter execution cooldown seconds** | 30 |
| **Repeatability metric** | train_and_eval_seconds |
| **Repeatability limit** | 0.05 |

## Draft Reference Results

These project-generated measurements demonstrate the current `max` paths on the disclosed reference system. Five-run records passed the project quality and repeatability checks. Provisional records establish execution and quality only; they do not establish repeatability. Quality decisions are recomputed against the current registry contract so a preserved historical target cannot make a stale pass claim. None are MLCommons-verified results.

| **Case** | **Evidence** | **Runs** | **Reference measurement** | **Quality** | **Repeatability** | **System** |

| training | One-run provisional | 1 | `train_and_eval_seconds` 719.819 mean | `test_accuracy` 0.7210 mean; target ≥ 0.7174; **pass** | Not established | Apple M5 Max; mps |

> Five-run verified means eligible for the project's future promotion import. One-run and two-run provisional records are not review eligible and make no repeatability claim.
